sources.label: Wikipedia, "14 Andromedae"
sources.quote: 14 Andromedae, abbreviated 14 And, also named Veritate, is a single, orange-hued giant star situated 248 light-years away in the northern constellation of Andromeda.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 68 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,509 K, so 13.58 solar radii.
